title: Auto Feeder Assembly Instructions
body_html:
Overview

The Auto Feeder is a modular accessory intended to automate material feed into a primary processing machine. The assembly process is straightforward and designed so that a single operator can complete it with commonly available hand tools.

Notes:

Assembly instructions can be found in this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lob4UFA0F6E&t=32s

 

Parts & Hardware 

Prepare and Identify All Components

 

1. Open the packaging of all components and place them on a clean work surface.

 

2. Identify all parts shown in the manual: 

  • User Manual
  • Conveyor Rail (Front)
  • Conveyor Rail (Rear)
  • Conveyor Rail Support
  • Feeding Accessory Main Unit
  • Conveyor Rail Support Pad
  • L-Wrench
  • Screws M5*14
  • Screws M5*20
  • Screws M3*8
  • Screws M3*10
  • Tray (removable)

 

Assembly — step-by-step

For a more detailed installation guide, please refer to the YouTube video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lob4UFA0F6E

Case 1: Cutting materials with a thickness of 0 mm < H ≤ 8 mm (without spacers)

Step 1 - Adjust Base Plate Position

1. Remove the honeycomb panel. Pull out the XRF/XT base plate.

2. Reinsert the third or lower placement layer from the top, which assists in the installation of the feeding accessory.

 

Step 2 - Place the Feeding Accessory Main Unit

1. Pull out the base plate approximately 10cm from the front corner bracket.

2. Place the feeding accessory main unit.

Caution:
There are two locations where riser blocks can be installed when assembling the Auto Feeder:

  • At the feeding accessory main unit: Installing the riser blocks increases the feeding clearance, allowing the Auto Feeder to accommodate thicker materials.
  • At the bottom of the conveyor rail support bracket: Installing the riser blocks raises the height of the roller assembly to align it with the machine.

The riser blocks at these two locations cannot be used at the same time. Installing both sets will result in a height mismatch and prevent proper assembly. Choose one installation location based on your application and follow the corresponding installation steps.

 

Step 3 - Install the Feeding Accessory Main Unit

1. Align the feeding accessory main unit with the corresponding holes on the equipment, as shown in "Step 3".

2. Tighten the screws in the corresponding positions using M5*14 hex socket screws.

 

Step 4 - Assemble the Conveyor Rails

1. Push and insert the conveyor rail support bracket to assemble it.Secure the conveyor rail support bracket using M3*8 thumb screws.

2. Install the conveyor rail support bracket to the rear area of ​​the conveyor rail, paying attention to the installation direction.

3. Assemble at least four conveyor rails in sequence.

 

Steps 5 & 6 - Install the Conveyor Rails

1. Pull out the base plate.

2. Snap the assembled conveyor rails into the corresponding positions on the front of the feeding accessory main unit. The distance between the conveyor rails can be adjusted according to the width of the material being processed.

3. Tighten the screws using M3*10 screws to secure the conveyor rails to their positions on the feeding accessory main unit.

 

 

Steps 7 & 8 - Installing Conveyor Rails

1. Align the corresponding holes of the new conveyor rail with the already installed one.

2. Tighten the new conveyor rail using M3*10 thumb screws.

3. Conveyor rails can also be installed or added to the rear of the feeding accessory main unit using the same method. Before installation, use cable ties to tidy up the exhaust pipe. 

4. The width between the conveyor rails on both sides of the front and rear of the feeding accessory main unit must be consistent.

 

Step 9 - Connecting the Feeding Accessory Main Unit and Equipment

1. Connect the feeding accessory main unit and equipment, tightening the interface.

2. Pay attention to the placement of the motor cables to prevent them from interfering with material processing.

Step 10 - Completing Assembly

1. As shown in Step 10, assembly is complete.

 

Case 2: Cutting materials with a thickness of 8 mm < H ≤ 14 mm (with spacers)

Step 1 - Adjust Base Plate Position

1. Remove the honeycomb panel. Pull out the XRF/XT base plate.

2. Reinsert the fourth or lower placement layer from the top, which assists in the installation of the feeding accessory.

 

Step 2 - Place the Feeding Accessory Main Unit

1. Install the two riser blocks on both sides of the feeding accessory main unit using M3*8 hex socket screws. 

2. Pull out the base plate approximately 10cm from the front corner bracket.

3. Place the feeding accessory main unit.

Caution:
There are two locations where riser blocks can be installed when assembling the Auto Feeder:

  • At the feeding accessory main unit: Installing the riser blocks increases the feeding clearance, allowing the Auto Feeder to accommodate thicker materials.
  • At the bottom of the conveyor rail support bracket: Installing the riser blocks raises the height of the roller assembly to align it with the machine.

The riser blocks at these two locations cannot be used at the same time. Installing both sets will result in a height mismatch and prevent proper assembly. Choose one installation location based on your application and follow the corresponding installation steps.

 

Step 3 - Install the Feeding Accessory Main Unit

1. Align the feeding accessory main unit with the corresponding holes on the equipment, as shown in "Step 3".

2. Tighten the screws in the corresponding positions using M5*20 hex socket screws.

 

Step 4 - Assemble the Conveyor Rails

1. Push and insert the conveyor rail support bracket to assemble it.Secure the conveyor rail support bracket using M3*8 thumb screws.

2. Install the conveyor rail support bracket to the rear area of ​​the conveyor rail, paying attention to the installation direction.

3. Assemble at least four conveyor rails in sequence.

 

Steps 5 & 6 - Install the Conveyor Rails

1. Pull out the base plate.

2. Snap the assembled conveyor rails into the corresponding positions on the front of the feeding accessory main unit. The distance between the conveyor rails can be adjusted according to the width of the material being processed.

3. Tighten the screws using M3*10 screws to secure the conveyor rails to their positions on the feeding accessory main unit.

 

 

Steps 7 & 8 - Installing Conveyor Rails

1. Align the corresponding holes of the new conveyor rail with the already installed one.

2. Tighten the new conveyor rail using M3*10 thumb screws.

3. Conveyor rails can also be installed or added to the rear of the feeding accessory main unit using the same method. Before installation, use cable ties to tidy up the exhaust pipe. 

4. The width between the conveyor rails on both sides of the front and rear of the feeding accessory main unit must be consistent.

 

Step 9 - Connecting the Feeding Accessory Main Unit and Equipment

1. Connect the feeding accessory main unit and equipment, tightening the interface.

2. Pay attention to the placement of the motor cables to prevent them from interfering with material processing.

The recommended setup is shown in the figure below:

 

Step 10 - Completing Assembly

1. As shown in Step 10, assembly is complete.

 

Usage Precautions

  • When processing soft, thick sheets, please apply PET tape to the back of the material before processing.
  • If the material being processed is close to the edge of the pressure roller on the main feeding accessory, the pressure roller will interfere with the machine.
  • Rotate the upper knob clockwise to press the pressure roller down, preventing the material from slipping or shifting during conveying. (A pressure roller pressure setting chart is recommended for commonly used materials.)
  • For fine-tuning of the material position, rotate the lower knob.
  • Setting the cutting break point.
